summary: Iteration 13 targeted regression re-verification of iteration_12 code-quality changes: (1) test-fixture creds moved to env-var-with-fallback (TEST_ADMIN_EMAIL/TEST_ADMIN_PASSWORD) across 3 test files, (2) Discover.js photo-dot React key changed from key={i} to key=`${candidate.user_id}-dot-${i}`. Backend: 8/8 tests passed in test_feed_seed.py (login, explore feed with 15 seed storytellers, real image bytes >5000, upload-post-appears-in-feed roundtrip, seed idempotency, non-admin 403, cleanup, public teaser, ghost users hidden). Pytest --collect-only succeeded with 8 items collected — env.get() refactor did not break imports. Frontend: Login with admin creds succeeded, /feed loaded 83 rendered images (including just-uploaded TEST_feed_upload_* JPG at top), /discover rendered swipe card for Noor Hassan (single-photo candidate — dots strip correctly not rendered per documented behavior; key change verified in code inspection). No behavioral regressions detected. Native mobile Bearer flow (api.js) was not modified and left untouched.
critical_code_review_comments: env.get() fallback pattern (TEST_ADMIN_EMAIL/TEST_ADMIN_PASSWORD) is correct — hardcoded default kept for backward compat, tests pass without env vars set.

Discover.js key change from key={i} to key=`${candidate.user_id}-dot-${i}` is a proper React-key uniqueness fix — no functional change, avoids stale DOM reconciliation when swiping between candidates with different photo counts.
Minor: 1 background 404 console warning observed during feed load (likely favicon/manifest asset, not a test-blocker).
seed_data_creation: None — used existing seed data; test upload created TEST_feed_upload_* post which persisted to feed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration_13 confirms the 2 minimal code-quality changes from iteration_12 review did NOT regress anything. Full backend regression via test_feed_seed.py (8/8 passing) and frontend spot-checks on /feed and /discover are green. Native mobile localStorage token flow was intentionally left untouched by main agent and not re-tested here.
